newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air mail falls 13.6 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air mail falls 13.6 pct in Sept.

text.p: Air mail volume at Frankfurt Airport fell 13.6 percent to 11,851 tonnes in September, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
Domestic post declined 23.2 percent to 7,045 tonnes while international post rose 5.5 percent to 4,611 tonnes, the FAG market research department said in its latest monthly report.
The monthly fall was the second-highest in the last 15 years and was mostly due to a large-scale transfer of post to road transport, the report said.

The overnight post volume tumbled more than 25 percent because of two missing working days in September and the high amount registered the previous year, it added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
